title: The bottle bought long ago
hook: Two stated cases: explore the historical cost versus the remaining use decision.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the historical cost versus the remaining use decision affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the historical cost versus the remaining use decision in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy decision has future benefit 30, future cost 0, and an unrecoverable past cost 20. What is the future net benefit?
